data.question: Is Brett Leatherman personally named as a WEF Partnership against Cybercrime participant?
data.method: Final-depth exact-name review of official WEF contributor and membership records, reconciled with official FBI role records.

findings.finding: The FBI is listed by WEF as a Partnership against Cybercrime member organization.
FBI Cyber Division experts participated in the 2020 WEF study.
The named FBI contributors are Steven Kelly and Mike Shanahan.
Brett Leatherman is not named in the 2020 report acknowledgement list.
No official source reviewed names Leatherman personally as a WEF member, contributor, adviser or attendee.

conclusions: The Leatherman-to-WEF institutional path is verified and suitable for the WEF dataset.
Do not characterize the edge as personal WEF membership.
Stop recursion at maximum depth because the requested link is established and the personal-name question is resolved as not established.
limitations: The WEF PDF endpoint timed out in the browser fetch path; indexed official-document text exposed the relevant acknowledgement and annex entries.
Private or unpublished attendee records were not available.
